title: Pandas DataFrame Architecture & Selection Simulator
description: Trace 2D tabular memory layout, column extraction (Series vs DataFrame), row and cell selection (.loc vs .iloc), in-place modification, and calculated column creation.

steps.title: Instantiate 2D DataFrame in Memory
steps.explanation: Pandas binds columns into a 2D tabular grid. The DataFrame maintains a row index [0, 1, 2, 3] and column index ['Name', 'Age', 'Mark']. Shape is (4, 3).

steps.title: Single Column Extraction (Series)
steps.explanation: Extracting one column using df['Mark'] yields a 1D Pandas Series. The DataFrame's row index becomes the Series index.

steps.title: Multiple Column Selection (DataFrame)
steps.explanation: Passing a list of column names inside double brackets df[['Name', 'Mark']] extracts a sub-table, returning a new 2D DataFrame with shape (4, 2).

steps.title: Row Selection with .iloc
steps.explanation: .iloc[0] performs a positional lookup at index 0, returning Arun's complete record (Name: Arun, Age: 20, Mark: 80) as a Series.

steps.title: Exact Cell Coordinate Access with .loc
steps.explanation: .loc[1, 'Mark'] targets the intersection coordinate of row label 1 and column 'Mark', extracting scalar value 92.

steps.title: Vectorized Column Addition (Bonus Marks)
steps.explanation: Vectorized addition calculates Mark + 5 across all rows in parallel, dynamically appending the 'UpdatedMark' column to the table. Shape expands to (4, 4).

steps.title: In-Place Cell Mutation
steps.explanation: .loc mutates Rahul's mark from 75 to 78 in-place, and UpdatedMark recalculates to 83.

steps.title: Conditional Feature Engineering (Result Column)
steps.code: df['Result'] = ['Pass' if m >= 40 else 'Fail' for m in df['UpdatedMark']]
steps.explanation: Evaluates pass/fail status across UpdatedMark (>= 40 -> Pass). The table expands to (4, 5) with full business analytics.
